articles.title: Think Multilingual, Not Harder: A Framework for Analyzing and Teaching Code-Switched Reasoning
articles.abstract: Reasoning capabilities have enabled large language models to solve increasingly complex tasks. Interestingly, while reasoning models are often trained to generate monolingual text, these models have also been observed to code-switch (i.e., mix languages). Prior works have either viewed code-switching as an undesirable error, attempted to control code-switching through modifications to input prompts or the output decoding process, or focus on narrow subsets of languages, domains, tasks, and models. We address these gaps by introducing the first linguistically and behaviorally motivated fine-tuning framework for identifying beneficial code-switched reasoning behaviors in large language models and teaching these models to code-switch more effectively for reasoning. First, we create the Code-Switched Reasoning (CoRe) corpus, consisting of 7k reasoning traces from 15 models, 18 languages, 10 scripts, and diverse reasoning domains, providing insights into potentially helpful code-switching behaviors. Then, we expand CoRe into the Extended Code-Switched Reasoning corpus (EnCoRe) with 40 carefully curated datasets for training and evaluating six interventions on code-switching in reasoning across three models and seven languages, totaling 120 fine-tuning conditions. Across 80k+ reasoning traces from both language/culture-agnostic and -specific evaluations, English-dominated reasoning, semantically accurate code-switching, and a more even mix of languages are positively associated with correct answers, whereas dense switching is associated with incorrect answers. Moreover, we are able to elicit positive behaviors through fine-tuning tasks that do not directly demonstrate code-switching. Our work suggests that small but well-curated datasets can change how reasoning models code-switch, allowing us to reap the benefits of reasoning in the many languages that lack large-scale reasoning data.
articles.comment: 47 pages, 13 figures; revised with added results and analysis
articles.titleCn: 思考多语种，而非更难：一个分析和教授代码转换推理的框架
articles.abstractCn: 推理能力使大型语言模型能够解决日益复杂的任务。有趣的是，虽然推理模型通常被训练生成单语文本，但这些模型也被观察到会语码转换（即混合语言）。以往的研究要么将语码转换视为不受欢迎的错误，尝试通过修改输入提示或输出解码过程来控制语码转换，要么专注于语言、领域、任务和模型的狭窄子集。我们通过引入第一个基于语言学和行为动机的微调框架来填补这些空白，该框架用于识别大型语言模型中的有益语码转换推理行为，并教会这些模型更有效地进行语码转换以进行推理。首先，我们创建了语码转换推理（CoRe）语料库，其中包含来自15个模型、18种语言、10种文字和多样化推理领域的7k条推理轨迹，为潜在的有助于语码转换的行为提供了见解。然后，我们将CoRe扩展为扩展语码转换推理语料库（EnCoRe），其中包含40个精心策划的数据集，用于在三个模型和七种语言上训练和评估六种关于推理中语码转换的干预措施，总共120个微调条件。在来自语言/文化无关和特定评估的80k+条推理轨迹中，以英语为主导的推理、语义准确的语码转换以及更均衡的语言混合与正确答案呈正相关，而密集的语码转换则与错误答案相关。此外，我们能够通过不直接展示语码转换的微调任务来引出积极行为。我们的研究表明，小但精心策划的数据集可以改变推理模型的语码转换方式，使我们能够从缺乏大规模推理数据的许多语言中获益。

articles.title: Geometric Factual Recall in Transformers
articles.abstract: How do transformer language models memorize factual associations? A common account views internal weight matrices as an associative memory. That account requires parameter counts that scale linearly with the number of facts. We develop a theoretical and empirical account of an alternative, \emph{geometric} form of memorization in which learned embeddings encode relational structure directly, and the MLP plays a qualitatively different role. In a controlled setting where a single-layer transformer memorizes random bijections from subjects to a shared attribute set, we prove that a logarithmic embedding dimension is sufficient. Subject embeddings encode \emph{linear superpositions} of their associated attribute vectors, and a small MLP acts as a relation-conditioned selector that extracts the relevant attribute from the embedding. We extend these results to the multi-hop setting---chains of relational queries such as ``Who is the mother of the wife of $x$?''---and provide constructions with and without chain-of-thought that exhibit a provable capacity--depth tradeoff, complemented by a matching information-theoretic lower bound. Empirically, gradient descent discovers solutions with the predicted structure. Causal experiments support the proposed mechanism: when subject embeddings are appropriately re-initialized, the frozen MLP transfers zero-shot to entirely new bijections, showing it has learned a generic selection mechanism rather than functioning as a key-value memory.
articles.abstractCn: 转换器语言模型如何记忆事实关联？一种常见的解释将内部权重矩阵视为关联记忆。这种解释要求参数数量与事实数量线性缩放。我们发展了一种理论及实证的解释，描述了一种替代的、几何形式的记忆方式，其中学习到的嵌入直接编码关系结构，而MLP（多层感知机）扮演着质地上不同的角色。在一个受控环境中，单层转换器记忆从主题到共享属性集的随机双射，我们证明了对数嵌入维度就足够了。主题嵌入编码其关联属性向量的线性叠加，一个小型MLP充当关系条件选择器，从嵌入中提取相关属性。我们将这些结果扩展到多跳设置——例如关系查询链“x的妻子是谁的母亲？”——并提供了有和没有思维链的构造，展示了可证明的容量-深度权衡，并辅以匹配的信息论下界。在实证上，梯度下降发现了具有预测结构的解决方案。因果实验支持了所提出的机制：当主题嵌入被适当重新初始化时，冻结的MLP可以零样本迁移到全新的双射，表明它学习了一种通用的选择机制，而不是作为键值记忆在运行。

articles.title: AVSD: Adaptive-View Self-Distillation by Balancing Consensus and Teacher-Specific Privileged Signals
articles.abstract: Self-distillation enables language models to learn on-policy from their own trajectories by using the same model as both student and teacher, with the teacher being conditioned on privileged information unavailable to the student. Such information can come in different types or views, such as solutions, demonstrations, feedback, or final answers. This setup provides dense token-level feedback without relying on a separate external model, but creates a fundamental asymmetry: the teacher may rely on view-specific information that the student cannot access at inference time. Moreover, the best type of privileged information is often task-dependent, making it difficult to choose a single teacher view. In this work, we address both these challenges jointly by introducing AVSD (Adaptive-View Self-Distillation), a novel method of self-distillation with multiple privileged-information views, which reconstructs token-level supervision by separating stable cross-view consensus from view-specific residual signals. AVSD identifies the consensus signal shared across views, which provides a reliable update direction, and then selectively adds the view-specific residual signal to adjust the update magnitude when it both aligns with the consensus direction and remains proportionate to the consensus signal. Experiments on math competition benchmarks (AIME24, AIME25, and HMMT25) show that AVSD consistently outperforms both single-view self-distillation baselines and GRPO, achieving average Avg@8 gains of 3.1% and 2.2% over the strongest baselines on Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-4B, respectively. Moreover, on code-generation benchmarks (Codeforces, LiveCodeBench v6) using Qwen3-8B, AVSD outperforms the single-view self-distillation baseline by 2.4% on average.
articles.titleCn: AVSD：通过平衡共识和教师特定特权信号的自适应视图自蒸馏
articles.abstractCn: 自蒸馏技术使语言模型能够通过使用相同的模型作为学生和教师，从自身的轨迹中学习策略，其中教师基于学生无法获取的特权信息进行条件化。此类信息可以有多种类型或视图，例如解决方案、演示、反馈或最终答案。这种设置在不依赖单独外部模型的情况下提供了密集的标记级反馈，但创造了一个基本的不对称性：教师可能依赖学生无法在推理时访问的视图特定信息。此外，最佳的特权信息类型通常是任务相关的，这使得选择单一教师视图变得困难。在这项工作中，我们通过引入AVSD（自适应视图自蒸馏），一种具有多重特权信息视图的新型自蒸馏方法，共同解决了这两个挑战。AVSD通过分离稳定的跨视图共识和视图特定残差信号来重建标记级监督。AVSD识别视图间共享的共识信号，该信号提供可靠的更新方向，然后选择性地添加视图特定残差信号来调整更新幅度，前提是它既与共识方向一致，又与共识信号成比例。在数学竞赛基准（AIME24、AIME25和HMMT25）上的实验表明，AVSD始终优于单视图自蒸馏基线和GRPO，在Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-4B上分别比最强基线平均提高了3.1%和2.2%的Avg@8。此外，在使用Qwen3-8B的代码生成基准（Codeforces、LiveCodeBench v6）上，AVSD平均比单视图自蒸馏基线提高了2.4%。

articles.title: Clause-Factored Bilateral State Grounding and Scoped Passivity for Counterfactual Open-World Deductive Reasoning
articles.abstract: Open-World Assumption (OWA) deduction requires distinguishing provable facts (True), refutations (False), and unprovable statements (Unknown) across counterfactual edits and unseen domains. Sequence and latent-recurrent transformers rely on distributional shortcuts, whereas chain-of-thought language models incur high autoregressive latency. We decompose OWA deduction into a clause-factored bilateral grounder ($F$) and a deductive deliberation operator ($B$), forming $B \circ F$ in Typed Edge-Factorized Bilateral Port-Hamiltonian Deliberation (TE-BPHD). Trained solely on three-way query labels without parsers or proof-depth annotations, TE-BPHD (37.85M parameters) maps clauses into a 1,440-dimensional Belnap space and propagates support through passivity-balanced implicit Port-Hamiltonian rule diodes. Across 17,036 locked ProofWriter test queries, TE-BPHD reaches 79.17 +/- 5.48% depth-5 counterfactual consistency (+23.83 to +38.67 percentage points over Seq2Seq T5, Flan-T5, and Recurrent-Depth T5) and 94.95 +/- 1.23% out-of-distribution (OOD) accuracy across 5,270 six-domain queries (92.54 +/- 3.38% macro-mean). On a paired 120-query OOD slice, TE-BPHD attains 93.61 +/- 4.59% versus 79.17% for 3-shot Qwen3-1.7B under a 2,048-token reasoning cap (+14.44 percentage points) at 9.44 versus 14,878.4 ms/query batch-16 NVIDIA L4 throughput. Operator interventions show that symmetric single-rule passivity prevents positive two-cycle modes seen in Gain-Matched Unilateral Horn (+50.00 percentage points counterfactual consistency), whereas unit-interval Grounded Product-T-Norm Logic Tensor Networks (LTN) achieve cycle-safe OOD transfer (94.50 +/- 0.87%) without linear solves, and multi-fact ParaRules prose exposes an upstream grounding trade-off (1.33 +/- 1.76% zero-shot vs. 34.11 +/- 5.01% with five-slot optimal-transport joint grounding).
articles.comment: 17 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Revised manuscript with expanded 17,036-query ProofWriter evaluation, 3-shot Qwen3-1.7B CoT comparison, Grounded Product-T-Norm LTN operator intervention, and updated Figure 2
articles.titleCn: 基于子句分解的双边状态指派与范围被动性在反事实开放世界演绎推理中
articles.abstractCn: 开放世界假设（OWA）推理需要区分可证明的事实（真）、反驳（假）以及不可证明的陈述（未知），这需要跨反事实编辑和未见过域进行区分。序列和隐态循环转换器依赖分布式捷径，而思维链语言模型则面临高自回归延迟。我们将OWA推理分解为一个子句分解的双向基础器（$F$）和一个演绎推理算子（$B$），在类型化边分解双向汉密尔顿推理（TE-BPHD）中形成$B \circ F$。仅基于三向查询标签，无需解析器或证明深度注释，TE-BPHD（37.85M参数）将子句映射到1,440维的贝尔纳普空间，并通过被动平衡隐式边汉密尔顿规则二极管传播支持。在17,036个锁定ProofWriter测试查询中，TE-BPHD达到79.17 +/- 5.48%深度5反事实一致性（比Seq2Seq T5、Flan-T5和循环深度T5高23.83至38.67个百分点）以及5,270个六域查询中94.95 +/- 1.23%的分布外（OOD）准确率（宏观平均92.54 +/- 3.38%）。在一个配对的120查询OOD切片中，TE-BPHD达到93.61 +/- 4.59%，而3-shot Qwen3-1.7B在2,048个token推理限制下为79.17%（高14.44个百分点），批处理16 NVIDIA L4吞吐量为9.44ms/查询与14,878.4ms/查询。算子干预显示，对称单规则被动性防止了增益匹配单边洪堡模式中出现的正两周期模式（反事实一致性高50.00个百分点），而单位区间基础产品T-Norm逻辑张量网络（LTN）无需线性求解实现周期安全OOD迁移（94.50 +/- 0.87%），多事实ParaRules文本暴露了上游基础权衡（1.33 +/- 1.76%零样本与34.11 +/- 5.01%具有五槽最优传输联合基础）。

articles.title: Enhancing Understanding of Language Models with Varied Explanations
articles.abstract: Language models are increasingly used to support human judgement in complex reasoning tasks, yet their predictions often remain difficult to interpret and validate. Explainability techniques provide insight into model decision-making, helping expose errors, failure modes, and potential bias so users can decide whether to rely on model outputs. Explanations are simplified approximations of a language model's internal workings. The goal is to obtain explanations that reflect the underlying computation as closely as possible (faithfulness), are understandable to users (plausibility), and help them achieve their intended goals (utility). Evaluation protocols are essential for assessing these dimensions. This thesis studies highlight explanations, natural language explanations, and chain-of-thought reasoning. These forms offer complementary perspectives on model behaviour and exhibit distinct strengths and limitations across tasks. Producing explanations that satisfy multiple quality dimensions remains challenging, as does evaluating them reliably across forms and settings. This thesis aims to improve people's understanding of models' decision-making processes in complex reasoning tasks. First, it proposes two evaluation frameworks for assessing highlight explanations across multiple properties and explanation types, together with a meta-evaluation framework for examining the reliability of existing faithfulness metrics for chain-of-thought explanations. Second, it proposes two techniques that generate natural language explanations designed to be faithful to the model's prediction process while remaining concise, coherent, and helpful for understanding model decisions. Finally, a study of human-AI interaction explores the roles of evidence and explanations in helping users validate model verdicts in a fact-checking setting.
articles.titleCn: 通过多样化解释增强对语言模型的理解
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型越来越多地被用于支持人类在复杂推理任务中的判断，但它们的预测往往难以解释和验证。可解释性技术提供了对模型决策过程的洞察，帮助揭示错误、失效模式和潜在偏见，以便用户决定是否依赖模型输出。解释是对语言模型内部运作的简化近似。目标是获得尽可能接近底层计算的解释（忠实性），对用户而言易于理解（合理性），并帮助他们实现预期目标（效用）。评估协议对于评估这些维度至关重要。本论文研究重点包括高亮解释、自然语言解释和思维链推理。这些形式提供了对模型行为的互补视角，并在不同任务中展现出独特的优势和局限性。生成满足多个质量维度的解释仍然具有挑战性，同样，在多种形式和环境下可靠地评估它们也具有挑战性。本论文旨在增进人们对模型在复杂推理任务中决策过程的理解。首先，它提出了两个评估框架，用于评估高亮解释在多个属性和解释类型上的表现，以及一个元评估框架，用于检验现有思维链解释忠实性指标的可靠性。其次，它提出了两种生成自然语言解释的技术，旨在忠实于模型的预测过程，同时保持简洁、连贯，并有助于理解模型决策。最后，一项关于人机交互的研究探讨了证据和解释在帮助用户在事实核查场景中验证模型裁决中的作用。

articles.title: Pro$^2$ Agent: Scientific Problem Probing for Autonomous AI R&D
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can now autonomously conduct AI research by writing code and running experiments. They typically do so by iteratively optimizing a codebase, while ignoring the problem structure behind the task. This formulation is effective on simpler tasks, but on difficult problems it often gets stuck in the wrong solution region because the agent never explicitly represents its understanding of the problem. We introduce Pro$^2$ Agent, which shifts the primary state of autonomous AI research from a codebase state to a Problem State: an explicit structure of what problems prevent success and which solutions are likely to address them. Pro$^2$ Agent initializes the Problem State through comprehensive analysis of available resources and constraints. It then performs targeted research to relate the identified problems to candidate solutions. Through controlled hypothesis testing, the agent updates the importance of a suspected problem or the benefit brought by a candidate solution. On the complete MLE-Bench, Pro$^2$ Agent matches the best reported medal rate (70.7%) under the standard 24-hour budget and reaches 76.0% with a 48-hour budget, the highest medal rate reported on the complete benchmark. It also achieves competitive performance on PostTrainBench. In addition, it produces research notes for each task that make the research process transparent and reusable by human researchers.
articles.titleCn: Pro$^2$ 代理：自主人工智能研发中的科学问题探索
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理现在可以通过编写代码和运行实验来自主开展人工智能研究。它们通常通过迭代优化代码库来实现，但往往忽略了任务背后的问题结构。这种模式在简单任务上有效，但在复杂问题上常常陷入错误解区域，因为代理从未明确表达其对问题的理解。我们引入Pro$^2$ Agent，它将自主人工智能研究的主要状态从代码库状态转变为问题状态：一个明确的问题结构，即哪些问题阻碍成功以及哪些解决方案可能解决这些问题。Pro$^2$ Agent通过全面分析可用资源和约束来初始化问题状态。然后，它进行有针对性的研究，将识别出的问题与候选解决方案联系起来。通过受控的假设测试，代理更新疑似问题的重要性或候选解决方案带来的效益。在完整的MLE-Bench测试中，Pro$^2$ Agent在标准24小时预算下达到了最佳报告奖牌率（70.7%），在48小时预算下达到了76.0%，这是该完整基准测试报告的最高奖牌率。它还在PostTrainBench上取得了具有竞争力的表现。此外，它为每个任务生成研究笔记，使研究过程对人类研究人员透明且可重用。

articles.title: Incorporating argumentation frameworks for LLM decision-making: Task-specific design and evaluation
articles.abstract: Argumentation frameworks (AFs) provide explicit, formal mechanisms for representing and resolving conflicts and thus have been incorporated into large language model (LLM) decision-making. The benefits vary and depend on how arguments and their relations are constructed, evaluated, and incorporated into the decision process. {We abstract a workflow consisting of four stages based on existing argumentation-augmented methods} and investigate their design choices over tasks of debate-based decision-making and retrieval-based fact verification. Our evaluation with recent LLMs shows that existing methods do not consistently improve performance across the considered tasks. Motivated by this observation, we develop two task-specific methods. The first is called Qnt-Arg, which organizes arguments around the original speakers in debate materials and aggregates model-estimated argument strengths and candidate-answer priors under gradual semantics. The second is Qlt-Arg that uses credibility estimates to establish preferences between conflicting evidence items and applies grounded semantics to select acceptable evidence for subsequent LLM inference. We examine the roles of generative and decision models within the two methods. In the debate setting, Qnt-Arg consistently outperforms other argumentation-augmented methods across matched configurations; Qlt-Arg improves retrieval-based fact-verification performance compared with the baselines. These findings demonstrate the value of combining formal argumentation and LLM while highlighting the importance of aligning with tasks in argumentation construction, model selection, and the role of formal semantic reasoning.
articles.titleCn: 将论证框架融入大语言模型决策：特定任务的设计与评估
articles.abstractCn: 论证框架（AFs）为表示和解决冲突提供了明确、形式化的机制，因此已被整合到大型语言模型（LLM）的决策过程中。其效益因应如何构建、评估和将论点及其关系融入决策过程而异。我们基于现有的论证增强方法抽象出一个包含四个阶段的流程，并研究了其在基于辩论的决策任务和基于检索的事实验证任务中的设计选择。我们的评估结果表明，现有的方法并未在所考虑的任务中始终提升性能。基于这一观察，我们开发了两种任务特定的方法。第一种称为Qnt-Arg，它围绕辩论材料中的原始发言者组织论点，并在渐进语义下聚合模型估计的论点强度和候选答案先验。第二种是Qlt-Arg，它使用可信度估计在冲突的证据项之间建立偏好，并应用扎根语义来选择后续LLM推理的可接受证据。我们考察了这两种方法中生成模型和决策模型的作用。在辩论场景中，Qnt-Arg在匹配配置下始终优于其他论证增强方法；Qlt-Arg相较于基线提升了基于检索的事实验证性能。这些发现证明了结合形式论证和LLM的价值，同时突出了在论证构建、模型选择和形式化语义推理作用方面与任务保持一致的重要性。

articles.title: ChronoDossier: Long-Form Personas as Temporal Memory Representations
articles.abstract: Long-horizon agents rely on stored records to recover a person's state as facts change. Reliable answers depend on how facts are recorded, retrieved, and presented to the reader. We treat a long-form persona dossier as a memory representation of a known latent state, an invariant identity plus a timeline of facts, routines, and decision rules tied to life phases. We present ChronoDossier, a benchmark of 311 synthetic dossiers of 1k-10k words written by seven generators from dated timelines. Intrinsic metrics evaluate the records against their intended states; extrinsic metrics test recovery by five readers on a seeded 32-persona GPT-5.1 panel balanced across lengths (520 rated turns per condition). The linked states, records, evidence packets, and answers support tests of construction and evidence delivery. In a contextual-stress control, tag-scoped writer inputs remove detected out-of-scope anchor copying. Frozen questions authored on staged dossiers transfer less reliably to one-pass dossiers of the same states. In matched evidence controls, whole sections repair 29 of 32 GPT-5.1 and 25 of 30 Sonnet 4.6 failures labeled as packaging, compared with 2 of 8 and 1 of 8 answer-formation failures. Attribution uses separate key-based and key-free support measures, with model disagreements retained. Length remains confounded with persona and question composition; the observed between-bucket widening depends on excerpt construction. The benchmark supports offline evaluation against known facts. Memory acquisition from interaction and validation against real users remain outside its scope.
articles.comment: 28 pages, 4 figures, 32 tables. Under review at ICLR 2027. Code and data: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ICLR_CHRONODOSSIER-4BCF
articles.titleCn: ChronoDossier：长篇角色作为时间记忆的表征
articles.abstractCn: 长时程智能体依赖存储记录来根据事实变化恢复个体的状态。可靠的答案取决于事实的记录、检索和呈现方式。我们将长篇人物档案视为已知潜在状态的记忆表示，即一个不变的身份标识加上与人生阶段相关的事实、行为模式和决策规则的时序记录。我们提出了ChronoDossier，这是一个包含311份由七个生成器根据日期时间线撰写的1k-10k字合成档案的基准。内在指标评估记录与其预期状态的一致性；外在指标通过在32个种子GPT-5.1人物小组（按长度均衡，每个条件520个评分回合）上的五个读者测试来评估恢复效果。关联状态、记录、证据包和答案支持构建和证据传递的测试。在情境压力控制中，标签范围作者输入会移除检测到的范围外锚点复制。在分阶段档案上撰写的冻结问题向同一状态的单次档案转移的可靠性较低。在匹配证据控制中，整个章节修复了32份GPT-5.1中的29份和30份Sonnet 4.6中的25份被标记为包装的失败，而答案形成失败仅为8份中的2份和8份中的1份。归因使用基于密钥和非密钥的支持措施，模型分歧保留。长度与人物和问题构成相互混淆；观察到的桶间差异取决于摘录构建。该基准支持针对已知事实的离线评估。交互中的记忆获取和针对真实用户的验证仍在其范围之外。

articles.title: Evolve Where It Matters: Coverage-Guided Self-Evolution of Agent Skills
articles.abstract: Agent skills package procedural knowledge as natural-language instructions, and a skill helps only when its instructions are correct and properly followed by the agent. Self-evolving agents revise their own skills from the runs they make, but existing methods judge each run as a whole, by its outcome or by where it went wrong, and cannot tell whether a failure comes from a wrong instruction or from one the agent did not follow. Instruction-level coverage was introduced to test skills and labels each instruction of a run as follow, not-follow, or not covered, which separates these causes. We leverage it for skill self-evolution with SkillPlumber, a framework in which an agent evolves its own skills where coverage shows they fall short. A persistent root cause analysis agent turns each label into a revision question and checks each revision against the next run, while a maintainer distills investigations across tasks into a shared strategy library. Across three benchmarks and three executors, SkillPlumber solves 64.7% to 70.5% of the tasks, 25.6 to 30.4 percentage points higher than the initial skill and 8.7 to 14.0 percentage points higher than the strongest baseline, and removing coverage reduces recovered failures by 20.8% on SkillsBench with GPT-5.5.
articles.titleCn: 在关键领域进化：基于覆盖引导的智能体技能自进化
articles.abstractCn: 智能体技能包将程序性知识编码为自然语言指令，只有当指令正确且智能体正确遵循时，技能才能发挥作用。自进化智能体根据其运行情况修订自身技能，但现有方法将每次运行作为一个整体进行评判，依据其结果或错误发生之处，无法判断失败是由错误指令引起还是由智能体未遵循指令造成。我们引入指令级覆盖率测试，将每次运行中的每条指令标记为遵循、未遵循或未覆盖，从而区分这些原因。我们利用这一方法进行技能自进化，通过SkillPlumber框架——这是一个智能体在覆盖率显示其不足之处时进化自身技能的框架。一个持续的根本原因分析智能体将每条标签转化为修订问题，并在每次运行中检查每个修订，同时一个维护者将跨任务的调查结果提炼为共享策略库。在三个基准测试和三个执行器上，SkillPlumber解决了64.7%至70.5%的任务，比初始技能高25.6至30.4个百分点，比最强基线高8.7至14.0个百分点，并且移除覆盖率导致SkillsBench上GPT-5.5恢复的失败率降低了20.8%。

articles.title: RoCoKV: Accelerating LLM Inference Serving through Uncertainty and Redundancy Aware KV Cache Compression
articles.abstract: KV cache compression is critical for large reasoning models, where most of the cost comes from long generated reasoning traces rather than the input prompt. These traces often contain redundant and low-utility tokens due to looping, self-verification, and corrections. However, such tokens may still receive high attention scores, making it difficult to remove them without harming the reasoning process. We propose RoCoKV, a KV cache compression method designed for large reasoning models. RoCoKV introduces two key components. First, uncertainty-guided adaptive pruning adjusts the compression strength based on the model's confidence, allocating more memory during uncertain phases and applying stronger pruning when the model is confident. Second, redundancy-aware token selection reduces the impact of tokens that are highly similar to recent reasoning content, encouraging the model to retain more informative and diverse tokens. Beyond the algorithm, we co-design RoCoKV with the serving stack: we develop fused three-phase CUDA decode kernels and integrate them into vLLM as a drop-in plugin that preserves its paged KV layout and CUDA graph capture, turning algorithmic savings into real end-to-end speedups. Extensive experiments across three reasoning benchmarks and two reasoning models demonstrate that RoCoKV consistently improves reasoning accuracy under constrained KV cache budgets, achieving higher accuracy compared to state-of-the-art KV cache compression methods. For DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B in vLLM, RoCoKV achieves a 1.27X speedup and 38% higher throughput on AIME25, the most challenging evaluated reasoning benchmark, and a 1.43X speedup and 45% higher throughput on the long synthetic benchmark, compared with Full-KV.
articles.titleCn: RoCoKV：通过不确定性和冗余感知的KV缓存压缩加速LLM推理服务
articles.abstractCn: 对于大型推理模型而言，KV缓存压缩至关重要，因为大部分成本源于冗长的推理轨迹而非输入提示。这些轨迹由于循环、自我验证和修正，往往包含冗余和低效的token。然而，这些token可能仍会获得较高的注意力分数，使得在不损害推理过程的情况下难以移除它们。我们提出了RoCoKV，一种专为大型推理模型设计的KV缓存压缩方法。RoCoKV引入了两个关键组件。首先，不确定性引导的自适应剪枝根据模型的置信度调整压缩强度，在不确定性较高的阶段分配更多内存，并在模型自信时应用更强的剪枝。其次，冗余感知的token选择减少与近期推理内容高度相似的token的影响，鼓励模型保留更多信息和多样化的token。除了算法之外，我们与服务栈协同设计了RoCoKV：我们开发了融合的三阶段CUDA解码内核，并将其集成到vLLM中，作为一个即插即用的插件，保留了其分页KV布局和CUDA图捕获，将算法节省转化为真实的端到端加速。在三个推理基准和两个推理模型上的大量实验表明，RoCoKV在受限的KV缓存预算下始终提高推理准确率，并优于最先进的KV缓存压缩方法。对于vLLM中的DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B，RoCoKV在最具挑战性的推理基准AIME25上实现了1.27倍的加速和38%的吞吐量提升，在长合成基准上实现了1.43倍的加速和45%的吞吐量提升，相较于Full-KV。

articles.title: PAIR-MED: Policy-reward Alternation for Iterative Refinement in Multilingual Medical Reasoning
articles.abstract: Large language models demonstrate strong medical question-answering capabilities, yet reasoning performance remains uneven across languages. Process reward models (PRMs) provide step-level feedback for improving reasoning, but a fixed PRM may become increasingly misaligned with the trajectory distribution of an evolving policy during reinforcement learning, thereby reducing the reliability of its supervision. We propose a policy--reward alternating training framework that jointly adapts a medical PRM and optimizes a multilingual reasoning policy. Following supervised initialization, the current policy generates multilingual trajectories to update the PRM, which then provides process-level rewards for the next policy update. Medical step supervision maintains the PRM's medical foundation, while process, outcome, and language-related rewards guide policy learning. We develop multilingual medical PRMs (PAIR-PRM) and reasoning models (PAIR-MED) at 8B and 9B scales across 12 languages. On the medical subsets of Global-MMLU and MMLU-ProX, our models improve average accuracy by 3.01--7.47% over their corresponding Qwen backbones. On CUREMED-BENCH, PAIR-MED-9B improves the joint language consistency and logical accuracy metric by 12.88% and 7.45% over baselines for in-domain and out-of-domain languages. Further analyses examine PRM adaptation, multilingual reasoning quality, and the contributions of individual training components.
articles.titleCn: PAIR-MED：多语言医学推理中迭代优化的策略-奖励交替方法
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型展现出强大的医学问答能力，但推理性能在不同语言间存在差异。过程奖励模型（PRMs）为提升推理能力提供步骤级反馈，但固定PRM在强化学习过程中可能逐渐与演化策略的轨迹分布产生偏差，从而降低其监督的可靠性。我们提出了一种策略-奖励交替训练框架，联合适配医学PRM并优化多语言推理策略。在监督初始化后，当前策略生成多语言轨迹更新PRM，随后PRM为下一策略更新提供过程级奖励。医学步骤监督维持PRM的医学基础，而过程、结果及语言相关奖励则指导策略学习。我们开发了规模为8B和9B、覆盖12种语言的医学PRMs（PAIR-PRM）和推理模型（PAIR-MED）。在Global-MMLU和MMLU-ProX的医学子集上，我们的模型相较于对应的Qwen主干模型平均准确率提升3.01--7.47%。在CUREMED-BENCH上，PAIR-MED-9B在领域内和领域外语言上分别将联合语言一致性和逻辑准确率指标提升了12.88%和7.45%。进一步分析考察了PRM适配、多语言推理质量以及各训练组件的贡献。

articles.title: PILAPS: A Bilingual Benchmark for Evaluating Pragmatic Inference across Phenomena and Settings
articles.abstract: Recent work reports strong pragmatic performance by large language models (LLMs) in English, yet whether this performance generalises across languages and evaluation settings remains unclear. This question is increasingly important as LLMs are deployed across languages, cultures, and conversational contexts. In this paper, we first introduce PILAPS, a bilingual English/Mandarin Chinese benchmark covering eight pragmatic phenomena across purpose-written and dialogue-derived items, with both culturally adapted and independently sourced data. We then evaluate eight LLMs from four families across a range of model sizes and prompting strategies. Our results reveal substantial variation across models and pragmatic phenomena: open-source models continue to struggle particularly with humour, while cross-linguistic performance varies with model origin. Our error analysis shows that, compared with human participants, models are more prone to literal interpretations in conversational contexts. Theory-of-Mind prompting lowers the literal share of errors, whereas Chain-of-Thought prompting slightly raises it. Together, these findings demonstrate that strong pragmatic performance in one evaluation setting does not necessarily generalise across languages or conversational contexts.
articles.titleCn: PILAPS：一个用于跨现象和场景评估语用推理的双语基准
articles.abstractCn: 近期研究报道大型语言模型（LLMs）在英语中表现出色，但其在不同语言和评估环境中的表现是否具有泛化性尚不明确。随着LLMs被应用于多种语言、文化和对话场景，这一问题日益重要。本文首先介绍了PILAPS，一个涵盖英语/普通话的双语基准，它包含八种语用现象，涵盖目的编写和对话衍生项目，既有文化适应的数据，也有独立来源的数据。随后，我们评估了来自四个系列的八种LLMs，涵盖不同模型大小和提示策略。我们的结果表明，不同模型和语用现象之间存在显著差异：开源模型在幽默方面仍存在困难，而跨语言表现则因模型来源而异。错误分析显示，与人类参与者相比，模型在对话环境中更倾向于字面解释。心智理论提示降低了错误中的字面解释比例，而思维链提示则略微提高了这一比例。综合这些发现，表明在一种评估环境中的出色语用表现并不一定能在不同语言或对话环境中泛化。

articles.title: When Should a Voice Agent Speak? End-of-Turn Detection in Turkish
articles.abstract: A voice agent that waits for a fixed silence before replying either interrupts users who pause mid-utterance or responds late to users who have finished. This study examines the decision at the onset of silence, using turn ends and turn-internal pauses extracted from the Real-TurnTurk corpus of Turkish dyadic video calls. A fine-tuned Turkish TurnGPT model, a zero-shot Turkish language model and a deployed multilingual detector are compared, together with voice-activity timing and facial features, under recording-disjoint and speaker-disjoint evaluation with paired cluster bootstrap tests. On held-out recordings, the fine-tuned model separates turn ends from pauses better than both text baselines and is the best calibrated of the three. Timing features of the current speaker are similarly informative, and their combination with the fine-tuned text score gives the best timing-based results; with logistic regression, this combination also outperforms the same combination with either text baseline. In a latency simulation, adding the text score to a silence timeout shortens the mean response delay at the same interruption rate. On automatic Whisper transcripts, the fine-tuned model retains its advantage over the zero-shot model.
articles.titleCn: 何时语音代理应发声？土耳其语的回合结束检测
articles.abstractCn: 一个在固定静默后回复的语音代理，要么会打断中途停顿的用户，要么会延迟回复已完成发言的用户。本研究考察了静默开始时的决策，使用了从土耳其双人视频通话的Real-TurnTurk语料库中提取的回合结束和回合内停顿。比较了微调的土耳其TurnGPT模型、零样本土耳其语言模型以及部署的多语言检测器，并结合语音活动时间和面部特征，在记录不重叠和说话人不重叠的评估中，使用配对聚类自举检验。在保留的录音中，微调模型比文本基线更好地区分回合结束和停顿，并且是三者中校准最好的。当前说话人的时间特征同样具有信息量，将其与微调文本分数结合给出了最佳的时间结果；使用逻辑回归时，这种结合也优于与任一文本基线结合的组合。在延迟模拟中，将文本分数添加到静默超时中，在相同的打断率下缩短了平均响应延迟。在自动Whisper字幕中，微调模型仍保持优于零样本模型的优势。
